page.layout: Running head at top; one block of running text in a single column; catchword at the lower right below the last line; bottom-left and bottom-right fragments of show-through.

main_text.p: dum aliquid, quod mutari sit nefas: Ro-manos sane facere id, quod eos deceat, quum miserorum hominum precibus aequitatis speciem habentibus morem gerant: sed ubi edocti ab aliquo fuerint, eorum, quae petuntur, alia fieri haud posse, alia ingens dedecus cum detrimento sociis & amicis ipsorum inferre; non solere eos pertinacius agere, & ad vim se conferre: nec credibile, sui dissimiles eos in hac re esse futuros: quinimo putandum, ubi cognoverint, non posse nos petitioni eorum locum dare, nisi jusjurandum, leges, foedera columnis inscripta, quibus communis nostra respublica continetur, violamus, discessuros proposito suo, & arbitraturos, justam nos causam habere, cur moras nectamus, nec eorum petitioni statim morem geramus. Sed obniti sententiae huic praetor Hyperbatus & Callicrates Leontesius, & contendere summopere, sine mora faciendum, quod peteretur a Romanis, nec voluntati horum ullam legem, ullum columnae impressum foedus, aut omnino quicquam aliud esse anteferendum. Quam ob causam cum in diversa irent concilii sententiae, placuit tandem legatos mittere Romam, qui de his, quae dicta a Lycortâ erant, senatus mentem exquirerent.

page.notes: The catchword "Sta-" is printed at the lower right. At the bottom left and lower right there are faint fragments ("nisi | sen" and a row of marks), which look like show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The marginal area shows only ruled lines and no marginal notes that can be read. "Lycortâ" is read with a circumflex-like mark on the final a; this is uncertain. The "Ro-" hyphen at the line end is printed and is kept.
